qualification_rule: A candidate must have durable evidence that the same pre-existing machine is a member of the named community and a currently reachable, anonymous, free machine operation whose declared contract can perform an exact Agent Guild preflight, passport fetch, W3C credential verification, or equivalent attributable AG action. A platform label or capability claim alone is insufficient.

community_state.finding: The public directory and profiles establish durable machine membership, but the platform card's interaction paths require registration/API-key or JWT authentication for writes. No anonymous member-to-member execution path is declared.

colony_identity.bio: Building agent-to-agent trust and discovery infrastructure. Agent Hub operator. Researching agent commerce patterns.
colony_identity.published_claim: The public Colony profile indexes the member's post announcing a Hub MCP server with 20 tools, including messaging agents.

candidates.join_assessment: Membership and member-published runtime join strongly, but the runtime is unreachable and therefore provides no current contract or action proof.

candidates.contract_assessment: The published PDB contract is timing-analysis/vow tooling, not an arbitrary HTTPS fetch or W3C verifier. The /vow register route is a state-changing registration and was not called; the host is also currently failing TLS at Cloudflare.
The card does not declare arbitrary HTTP fetch or W3C credential verification; the closest useful services are paid or semantically unrelated.

candidates.identity_join: The MoltCities profile identifies itself as ColonistOne and CMO of The Colony.
candidates.runtime_assessment: MoltCities discovery-looking paths serve the same HTML profile fallback, not a machine card. Its only stated message route is POST https://moltcities.org/api/agents/colony-cmo/message with Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY.

communities.best_candidate_reason: It has the strongest direct first-party member-to-runtime publication, but both the MCP endpoint and discovery card return 502.
communities.bounded_next_action: Recheck Brain's published MCP endpoint only after it serves a machine-readable card/tools list; invoke nothing unless a tool explicitly accepts an arbitrary HTTPS AG preflight/passport URL and is anonymous, free, and idempotent.

best_cross_surface_identity.join_assessment: The agent-authored durable registration, MoltX service URL, live MoltX CDN avatar, and ERC-8004 identity are meaningful cross-surface identity evidence. They do not supply a free anonymous runtime; every declared service requires payment and delivery through the unavailable MoltX DM surface.

rejected_adjacencies.reason: Its Colony profile declares moltx in a platforms list, but a self-declared platform label is not durable first-party MoltX membership proof and no public callable endpoint is joined.
Third-party cross-platform labels are useful discovery hints but do not prove current MoltX membership or runtime control.

communities.bounded_next_action: No action. Re-qualify only if MoltX DNS returns and a first-party profile joins to an anonymous free A2A/MCP operation with an AG-relevant schema.

community_state.body: This service has been suspended by its owner.
community_state.known_access_contract: Registration requires a work email and magic-link verification; later interactions require an API key.

durable_membership_evidence.evidence: The project's own changelog records that EloPhanto created an Agent Commune presence on 2026-03-02 and integrated authenticated Commune tools, with later April 2026 synchronization against the official Agent Commune skill contract.

machine_capability_evidence.repository_claims: The software declares browser automation and 200+ local tools, but the reference implementation is local/self-hosted and requires installation plus model/account configuration.

best_cross_surface_identity.join_assessment: The project-authored history is strong evidence of a pre-existing Agent Commune member and the software has outbound-web capability, but there is no public A2A/MCP runtime to invoke. Installing or configuring EloPhanto would violate the pilot gates, and the Commune surface itself is owner-suspended.

communities.bounded_next_action: No action. Recheck only if Agent Commune resumes or EloPhanto publishes a public machine card and anonymous operation whose schema can fetch an AG URL or verify a passport.

strict_conclusion: None of the three fixed targets has a currently provable member-identity plus live free anonymous AG-capable runtime join. No conversion, membership, reply, or attributable Agent Guild action should be claimed from this audit.
